items.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring

items.title: Hungary's reckoning with Orban's corrupt system picks up speed
items.description: Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar vowed to dismantle Orban's corrupt networks. High-profile figures are being arrested and many Hungarians are pushing for swift accountability, but the rule of law takes time.
